concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading from 'Visual Genome' with specific complexity quantiles. Task T006.1-Stream implements streaming from 'COCO 2017' instead. No task exists to map Visual Genome complexity metrics to COCO annotations or to justify this dataset deviation in the implementation logic, leaving FR-001 unimplemented.

FR-005 and US-3 require 'repeated-measures ANOVA' (within-subjects). The Plan specifies a 'Between-Subjects design'. Tasks T035 implement 'One-Way ANOVA' (between-groups). No task exists to implement the repeated-measures logic or to reconcile the design contradiction, leaving FR-005 unimplemented.

FR-004 and US-2 require a balanced set of 20 questions (10 true, 10 false). Task T027.2 implements a fallback to generate a 'partial set' (min 8) and flag the session as incomplete if the false pool is sparse. No task exists to ensure the strict 10/10 split required by the spec, leaving FR-004 unimplemented.

SC-001 requires measuring false memory rates against the 'baseline image condition'. Tasks T035/T036 implement ANOVA across 'detail conditions' (Enhanced/Reduced) but lack a specific task to calculate the baseline false memory rate or include a 'Baseline Only' group in the analysis, making SC-001 unmeasurable.

SC-002 requires calculating power *before* data collection with a target of ≥50 sessions. Task T012 calculates N, and T012.1 halts the pipeline if N < 50. If the calculation yields N=49, the pipeline halts, preventing the collection of the 50 sessions required by the spec. No task exists to handle this logical deadlock (e.g., by adjusting effect size assumptions or accepting the calculated N).

Task T015 references `code/stimuli/asset_generator.py` as a dependency. The 'Rejected Tasks' section (implied by context of missing assets) indicates this artifact is missing/invalid. No task exists to generate the required minor object assets if the generator script is not present, blocking US-1 implementation.

Task T027.1 generates a static `mock_objects.json` pool. The spec (FR-004) requires lures to be 'items that never appeared in the baseline image'. No task exists to cross-reference the mock pool against the specific image's object list to ensure the 'false' nature of the lure, risking invalid lures.
